dependencies.unavailable_state: The named source package is identifiable but is not a CompanyState source.
dependencies.next: Bind a broader source-to-state adapter without renaming Apple or changing retained source bytes.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Consolidated reported balances do not identify legal books, control dates, eliminations or full concept mappings.
unsupported_scope: Fixed account registry has no complete mapping for the retained consolidated captions.
dependencies.next: Represent dated legal books and consolidation adjustments, or explicitly retain aggregate source constraints with unresolved mappings.

unsupported_scope: Full calendar year required; the retained fiscal year and quarter do not satisfy that scope.
dependencies.next: Specify fiscal start/end boundaries and separate reporting intervals from method accrual calendars.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Exact original-byte publication, ingestion and review clocks are unknown; named-source reading remains possible.
dependencies.next: Preserve named-source mode; require exact version clocks before making any historical as-of admission.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Displayed rounded totals do not supply a balanced exact trial balance, temporary-account closing state or a complete feasible history.
dependencies.next: Keep partial constraints and missing components explicit; require a complete compatible state and reviewed mappings before execution.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Cash and cash equivalents do not identify unrestricted entity cash, currency allocation or settlement accounts.
dependencies.next: Identify cash components, restrictions, legal ownership, currencies and gross settlement origins.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Aggregate balances do not identify claim IDs, counterparties, allocations, maturities, gross additions or settlement events.
dependencies.next: Supply supported claim schedules or preserve feasible allocation families without inventing individual claims.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Net inventory does not identify units, homogeneous unit cost, lots, write-downs or return-recovery memory.
unsupported_scope: Only homogeneous_cost is supported; no reviewed Apple mapping to this method exists.
dependencies.next: Represent lot or cohort alternatives and their measurement premises before applying an inventory method.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Net PPE does not identify gross cohorts, accumulated depreciation, lives, service dates, retirements or impairment state.
unsupported_scope: straight_line_full_year cannot infer missing cohort state or fiscal service fractions.
dependencies.next: Specify dated cohort memory, cost/accumulation constraints and explicit supported depreciation conventions.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Term-debt captions omit instrument terms, currency, rate resets, fees, noncash movements and gross financing history; a reported dash is not zero.
unsupported_scope: One annual coupon and fixed/floating principal model cannot represent the whole disclosed instrument set.
dependencies.next: Acquire instrument identity and terms; separate term-debt caption arithmetic from total financing obligations.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Available borrowing, eligibility, reserved capacity, rates, fees and financing decisions are not supplied by the displayed balances.
unsupported_scope: ACT365_calendar, zero opening facility draw and zero fees are finite target assumptions.
dependencies.next: Specify dated facilities, constraints and explicit funding behavior; do not manufacture balancing finance.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Jurisdictional tax bases, deductible timing, reversal schedules, recognition findings and settlements remain missing.
unsupported_scope: immediate_deductible is a diagnostic model choice, not an admitted Apple tax rule.
dependencies.next: Bind tax jurisdiction, measurement method and factual/review findings independently of source captions.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Actual dated events and future contract or behavioral assumptions are distinct and neither is identified by aggregate period totals.
dependencies.next: Supply traceable actual-event alternatives or explicit scenario assumptions; retain unknown behavior rather than fitting arbitrary events.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Return rights, expected refunds, recovery costs, component allocations and recovered-lot history are unavailable.
unsupported_scope: The operations profile has no shared return module.
dependencies.next: Specify externally evidenced return components and their relationship to the common book and claim state.

dependencies.unavailable_state: Complete report mappings, noncash origins, OCI, instruments, leases, group state and period carry memory remain unresolved.
unsupported_scope: Fixed accounts and simple report mappings exclude parts of the reported consolidated company.
dependencies.next: Use declared capability requirements and preserve every unsupported component; extend reports only with checked state/mapping semantics.

partial_state.coverage: Selected retained annual/interim balance captions; all other evidence and obligations remain in the bound readiness result.
